calk.definition:
n. a metal cleat on the bottom front of a horseshoe to prevent slipping
v. provide with calks
v. injure with a calk
calk.translation:
vt. 填...以防漏, 使不漏水, 装尖铁, 描摹复制
n. 尖铁

calked.translation: v. 堵（船的）缝( calk的过去式和过去分词 ); 泥…的缝; 填塞; 使不漏水

calker.definition:
n. One who calks.
n. A calk on a shoe. See Calk, n., 1.
calker.translation: [机] 敛缝工具, 敛缝工人

calkin.definition: n a metal cleat on the bottom front of a horseshoe to prevent slipping
calkin.translation: n. 马蹄铁底端的凹凸, 鞋底铁掌

calking.definition:
v provide with calks
v seal with caulking
v injure with a calk

calks.definition:
n a metal cleat on the bottom front of a horseshoe to prevent slipping

calks.translation:
